title: sim-sentinel: Windows notifications for background simulation completion, failure, or stalled progress
description:
sim-sentinel reads local simulation logs once a minute on Windows and sends a notification when a run finishes, fails, or stops moving. It reports state changes rather than sending a notification every minute. The included rules target Lumerical FDTD/EME <project>_p0.log files and can be adapted to other local text logs. Python uses only the standard library.

Scope. The tool supports Windows and local text logs only; cloud jobs are not covered. It does not submit or cancel simulations, and it does not judge convergence, energy balance, physics, or the correctness of results. The first sighting of a log establishes a silent baseline. Notification visibility depends on Windows settings. The process check recognizes names ending in -engine.exe; other process names require a code change for failure and stall detection.

Licence. Source code, tests, and automation scripts are MIT; written documentation and the screenshot are CC BY 4.0. This record uses "Other (Open)" because the licence field holds one identifier and cannot express the split.
